1: // Pixel Runner – minimal endless side‑scroller
2: // Canvas element with id="game" expected in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Audio context for simple sound effects
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
9:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
12:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
13:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     oscillator.start();
16:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
17:   }
18:   if (!canvas) {
19:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
20:     return;
21:   }
22:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
23:   const WIDTH = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
24:   const HEIGHT = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200);
25: 
26:   // ----- Game state -----
27:   // Added background gradient and ground line
28:   const bgGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
29:   bgGradient.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky blue
30:   bgGradient.addColorStop(1, '#FFFFFF'); // horizon
31:   const groundHeight = 20;
32: 
33:   let running = false;
34:   let score = 0;
35:   let highScore = Number(localStorage.getItem('pixelRunnerHigh') || 0);
36:   let speed = 3; // base scroll speed, increases over time
37:   let spawnTimer = 0;
38: 
39:   // ----- Player -----
40:   const player = {
41:     w: 20,
42:     h: 30,
43:     x: 50,
44:     y: HEIGHT - 30,
45:     vy: 0,
46:     jumpStrength: -9,
47:     gravity: 0.4,
48:     onGround: true,
49: draw() {
50:         // Player rendered with a simple gradient for visual appeal
51:         const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
52:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#FF0'); // bright top
53:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#FFA500'); // orange bottom
54:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
55:         ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
56:         // optional outline
57:         ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
58:         ctx.strokeRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
59:       }
60:     },
61: jump() {
62:         if (this.onGround) {
63:           this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
64:           this.onGround = false;
65:           // Play jump sound
66:           playBeep(440, 0.1);
67:         }
68:       }
69:     },
70:   };
71: 
72:   // ----- Obstacles -----
73:   const obstacles = [];
74:   const obstacleTypes = [
75:     { w: 20, h: 40 }, // spike
76:     { w: 30, h: 20 }, // block
77:   ];
78:   function spawnObstacle() {
79:     const type = obstacleTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * obstacleTypes.length)];
80:     obstacles.push({
81:       w: type.w,
82:       h: type.h,
83:       x: WIDTH,
84:       y: HEIGHT - type.h,
85:     });
86:   }
87: 
88:   function updateObstacles() {
89:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
90:       const o = obstacles[i];
91:       o.x -= speed;
92:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
93:     }
94:     // spawn logic
95:     spawnTimer--;
96:     if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
97:       spawnObstacle();
98:       spawnTimer = Math.max(60 - Math.floor(score / 100), 20); // faster as score grows
99:     }
100:   }
101: 
102:   function drawObstacles() {
103:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
104:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
105:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#8B0000'); // dark red top
106:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#FF4500'); // orange red bottom
107:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
108:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
109:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
110:       ctx.strokeRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
111:     });
112:   }
113: 
114:   // ----- Collision -----
115:   function checkCollision() {
116:     for (const o of obstacles) {
117:       if (
118:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
119:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
120:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
121:         player.y + player.h > o.y
122:       ) {
123:         return true;
124:       }
125:     }
126:     return false;
127:   }
128: 
129:   // ----- UI -----
130:   function drawUI() {
131:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
132:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
133:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
134:     ctx.fillText(`High: ${highScore}`, 10, 40);
135:   }
136: 
137:   // ----- Game Loop -----
138:   function drawBackground() {
139:     // Fill sky gradient
140:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGradient;
141:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT - groundHeight);
142:     // Draw ground
143:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321'; // brown ground
144:     ctx.fillRect(0, HEIGHT - groundHeight, WIDTH, groundHeight);
145:   }
146: 
147: function loop() {
148:     // Draw background gradient and ground
149:     drawBackground();
150:     if (running) {
151:       player.update();
152:       updateObstacles();
153:       if (checkCollision()) {
154:         endGame();
155:       }
156:       player.draw();
157:       drawObstacles();
158:       score++;
159:       if (score % 500 === 0) speed += 0.5; // gradually increase speed
160:       drawUI();
161:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
162:     } else {
163:       // Game Over screen
164:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
165:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
166:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
167:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
168:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
169:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 20);
170:       ctx.font = '16px monospace';
171:       ctx.fillText('Press Space or Click to Restart', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 10);
172:       ctx.textAlign = 'start';
173:     }
174:   }
175: 
176:   // ----- Controls -----
177:   function startGame() {
178:     // Ensure audio context is running (required after user gesture)
179:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') {
180:       audioCtx.resume();
181:     }
182:     // reset state
183:     obstacles.length = 0;
184:     score = 0;
185:     speed = 3;
186:     spawnTimer = 60;
187:     player.y = HEIGHT - player.h;
188:     player.vy = 0;
189:     running = true;
190:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
191:   }
192: 
193:   function endGame() {
194:     // Play collision sound on game over
195:     playBeep(150, 0.3);
196:     running = false;
197:     if (score > highScore) {
198:       highScore = score;
199:       localStorage.setItem('pixelRunnerHigh', highScore);
200:     }
201:     // Draw one more frame to show Game Over
202:     loop();
203:   }
204: 
205:   // Input listeners
206:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
207:     if (e.code === 'Space') {
208:       if (running) player.jump();
209:       else startGame();
210:     }
211:   });
212:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
213:     if (running) player.jump();
214:     else startGame();
215:   });
216: 
217:   // Auto‑start on load
218:   startGame();
219: })();
